feedback.problem: If $U={-8,-7,-6,…,8}$ is the universal set and $A={-7,-5,-3,…,7},$ then $\overset{―}{A}=$
feedback.worked_solution:
The complement of $A,$ denoted $\overset{―}{A},$ consists of every element in the universal set $U$ that is not in the set $A.$

The universal set $U$ consists of the integers from $-8$ through $8,$ while the set $A$ consists of the odd numbers from  $-7$ through $7.$

So, the only elements of $U$ that are not in $A$ are the even numbers from $-8$ through $8.$

Therefore, the complement of $A$ is

$$
\overset{―}{A}={-8,-6,-4,…,8}.
$$
